description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy (%) of various models as a function of the number of frames, with results shown for length extrapolation on the EgoSchema dataset. The x-axis represents the number of frames, ranging from 10 to 65, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis shows accuracy in percentage, ranging from 40% to 54%, with major gridlines at 2% intervals. Four models are compared: "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" (blue, solid line with circular markers), "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" (green, solid line with circular markers), "PLLaVA (DP 8)" (orange, solid line with square markers), and "PLLaVA (DP 16)" (red, solid line with square markers). The "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" and "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" models both achieve high accuracy, starting near 53% and 52.8% respectively at 10 frames and plateauing above 53.5% as the number of frames increases. In contrast, the "PLLaVA (DP 8)" model starts at approximately 45.2% and steadily declines to about 39.5% at 65 frames. The "PLLaVA (DP 16)" model begins at around 45.8% and decreases to approximately 42.2% over the same range.
